column1: # EXCLUDED.tsv -- spitbol_x32_tests: the programs of this package that are NOT IN THE SPITBOL DIALECT, out of the published denominator, one row per program: name<TAB>NOT_SPITBOL_DIALECT<TAB>the feature, its dialect, the oracle's own refusal and CSNOBOL4's verdict.

# THE TEST (Lon 2026-09-26 15:0x CDT, verbatim: "So the way to tell if a program is SPITBOL dialect is two-fold, 1st is rejected by SPITBOL, and 2nd why it is rejected is a CSNOBOL4 feature not supported. Then if these two are true it is NOT SPITBOL dialect."; ceo CEO-1286).

# These 21 are SPITBOL x32's own tests, SPITBOL dialect BY ORIGIN, and sbl -bf runs all 21 after the CEO-571 conversion (measured 2026-09-26): EXCLUDED=0. Kept present and empty: an absent declaration and an empty one are different statements.
